source: RFC 0007 §5.8; design B of the back-references, beta.5 (#1729)
statement: What a tenant's publish reads and writes does not depend on how many other documents refer to the same policies, for a reference it adds and for one it drops alike: it records what it adds in its own revision index before adding one member per reference, and drops exactly the members that record holds, without reading the sets.
guards: control:PublishCostTest#a tenant's publish that adds a reference costs the same at 10 and at 400 referrers
control:PublishCostTest#a tenant's publish that drops a reference costs the same at 10 and at 400 referrers
